import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = (
    r.moveTo(0.0476, 0.0474)
    .threePointArc((0.0, 0.095), (0.0476, 0.1426))
    .lineTo(0.5681, 0.1426)
    .threePointArc((0.5926, 0.1476), (0.6133, 0.1616))
    .threePointArc((0.6791, 0.19), (0.746, 0.1644))
    .threePointArc((0.7491, 0.1505), (0.7373, 0.1425))
    .lineTo(0.6811, 0.1425)
    .threePointArc((0.6336, 0.095), (0.6811, 0.0475))
    .lineTo(0.7373, 0.0475)
    .threePointArc((0.7491, 0.0395), (0.746, 0.0256))
    .threePointArc((0.6791, 0.0), (0.6133, 0.0284))
    .threePointArc((0.5926, 0.0424), (0.5681, 0.0474))
    .lineTo(0.0476, 0.0474)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0633)

# Final model
r  # This will be the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

t = 0.0633
hw = 0.13          # handle width
hy = 0.19 / 2.0    # handle center line
hx0 = 0.065        # handle left end center
hx1 = 0.62         # handle right end
hr = hw / 2.0      # handle radius
head_cx = 0.655    # head center
head_r = 0.095     # head radius
notch_w = 0.09     # jaw opening width
notch_x = 0.655    # notch end center

# Handle: rounded on left end, blends into head
handle = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(hx1, hy - hr)
    .lineTo(hx0, hy - hr)
    .threePointArc((hx0 - hr, hy), (hx0, hy + hr))
    .lineTo(hx1, hy + hr)
    .close()
    .extrude(t)
)

# Head: circular end of wrench
head = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(head_cx, hy)
    .circle(head_r)
    .extrude(t)
)

body = handle.union(head)

# Jaw opening: rectangular notch with rounded end, cut from the right side
notch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(head_cx + head_r + 0.01, hy + notch_w / 2.0)
    .lineTo(notch_x, hy + notch_w / 2.0)
    .threePointArc((notch_x - notch_w / 2.0, hy), (notch_x, hy - notch_w / 2.0))
    .lineTo(head_cx + head_r + 0.01, hy - notch_w / 2.0)
    .close()
    .extrude(t)
)

r = body.cut(notch)

# Translate so part sits within bounding box
r = r.translate((0, 0, 0))

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Wrench-like flat part, thickness (Z) = 0.0633
# X length 0.75, Y max width (head) 0.19 -> head radius 0.095
R = 0.095
Ox = 0.6592          # head center so jaw tips reach X = 0.75
handle_half = 0.045  # handle half width (0.09 wide)
th = 0.0633

# Left rounded end (semicircular cap)
left_cap = cq.Workplane("XY").center(handle_half, 0).circle(handle_half).extrude(th)

# Handle shank
handle = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.66 - handle_half, 2 * handle_half, th, centered=(True, True, False))
    .translate(((handle_half + 0.66) / 2.0, 0, 0))
)

# Round head (outer)
head = cq.Workplane("XY").center(Ox, 0).circle(R).extrude(th)

solid = left_cap.union(handle).union(head)

# Inner circular jaw (through cut)
jaw = cq.Workplane("XY").center(Ox, 0).circle(0.05).extrude(th)

# Mouth slot opening to +X (narrower than jaw so it forms a "C")
mouth = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.78 - Ox, 0.056, th, centered=(True, True, False))
    .translate(((Ox + 0.78) / 2.0, 0, 0))
)

r = solid.cut(jaw).cut(mouth)
